notes.title: 101XP Publisher Sale
notes.content:
What could be better than exciting discounts and hot new releases? We're happy to announce the launch of our very own publisher sale on Steam! Until [b]May 30[/b], grab all 101XP games at the best of prices!

[color=#27e827][b]Night is Coming[/b][/color] has just launched in Early Access! Dive into the world of dark fantasy and Slavic mythology: build your settlement, protect its inhabitants from monstrous creatures, and survive the encroaching Darkness. Each night is a deadly challenge, and every mistake could prove fatal. Command stern warriors, defend your people, and fight off the horrors that come crawling in the night.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1011590/Night_is_Coming/

[color=#27e827][b]The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante[/b][/color] invites you to experience existence from birth until death in a brutal realm shaped by law and fate. Critically acclaimed and deeply immersive, this narrative RPG challenges players to make painful decisions that lead to irreversible consequences.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/

Step into the retro-futuristic world of [color=#27e827][b]Dynopunk [/b][/color]where you play as Chris – a dinosaur mechanic with big dreams. Repair gadgets, listen to Lo-Fi beats, and discover touching stories that take place in a pixel-art cyberpunk city.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1596730/Dynopunk/

Put on the shoes of a government official in the acute, socially charged visual novel [color=#27e827][b]For the People[/b][/color]. Manage citizen requests, investigate hidden plots, and balance morality with political strategy.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146600/For_the_People/

Or maybe you're in the mood for an unforgettable atmospheric adventure? Then explore twisted folklore in [color=#27e827][b]The Darkest Tales[/b][/color], or fight your way through post-apocalyptic Japan as a blind cyber-samurai in [color=#27e827][b]Blind Fate: Edo no Yami[/b][/color].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1307690/The_Darkest_Tales/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294880/Blind_Fate_Edo_no_Yami/

Looking for pure action with no strings attached? Dive into relentless roguelike survival with [color=#27e827][b]FatalZone [/b][/color]or [color=#27e827][b]The Braves[/b][/color]! Let explosive combat and endless enemy waves keep you on edge. Destroy, survive, and upgrade your fighters in a whirlwind of chaos.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488510/FatalZone/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479830/The_Braves/

And if you want to grab multiple games – or already own a few of them – check out our curated bundles to get even more value with every purchase!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/101xp/sale/PublisherSale101XP][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37268497/c2747013b79cbb265d8dfda244e01048fd780c68.gif[/img][/url]

[color=#27e827][b]Wishlist our upcoming titles as well![/b][/color]

Side with evil in [color=#27e827][b]Lords of Ravage[/b][/color], a tactical fantasy game where you command one of the three Dark Lords, each with their own faction and unique units. Conquer regions, pass decrees, and crush the so-called heroes to dust.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1830320/Lords_of_Ravage/

[color=#27e827][b]The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian[/b][/color] is a narrative RPG told on the pages of the protagonist's journal. Become the heir to the Blessed Arknian Empire in a world ruled over by cruel but terribly real gods. Navigate a life of hard moral choices, palace intrigue, and cosmic mysteries that will shape the fate of both your character and his domain.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936290/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Prince_Jerian/

In [color=#27e827][b]Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths[/b][/color], you'll become the driver and the mechanic of a massive truck taking on treacherous South American terrain. Every journey is a challenge, and only the toughest can endure the road, the weather, and vehicle breakdowns.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/995680/Truck_Mechanic_Dangerous_Paths/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1105330/Dark_Moon/

These are the discounts worth catching – the 101XP Publisher Sale is a great chance to explore new worlds, genres, and unforgettable stories. Don't miss your chance – the sale runs through [b]May 30[/b]!

notes.title: The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian — a new narrative RPG from Schisma Games
notes.content:
It is our pleasure to announce a new narrative roleplay adventure from the minds behind [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/]The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante[/url]!

The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian is a narrative roleplaying game that casts the player as the heir to the Blessed Arknian Empire, who must carve out a destiny for his nation. The world is grim, and the gods are eager to punish anyone who breaks their commandments. People live preordained lives, their fates sealed the moment they are born. It is up to the player to decide what kind of leader they will be: uphold the established order, or build a new kind of future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936290/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Prince_Jerian/

You, Prince Jerian of House Tempest, must embark on a lifelong journey. It starts in your childhood, blissfully ignorant of your destiny, and continues into maturity as you take up a role you have been primed for since birth: emperor. As crown prince, you must not only understand your country and its culture, but also make many difficult choices that affect the fragile balance of powers in the Empire, and inside yourself. If you go where political circumstance and family obligations guide you, you risk losing yourself in the chaos. Can you keep yourself whole, or will you shatter?

Check out the trailer, which will give you some first impressions about the upcoming game!

[previewyoutube=LsJb0TVRytc;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition, to celebrate the official announcement of the game, we are releasing a special video address from the development team at Schisma Games, in which they will pull back the veil of mystery shrouding the contents of their upcoming title. Come watch!

[previewyoutube=RdUQLk17Vqo;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is currently in development. Wishlist The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian now and subscribe to our newsletter to never miss an update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38127382/e187dfde67bda82ee5d3133de0a985083203b26e.gif[/img]

Join our bustling [url=https://discord.gg/YWRm476CVE]Discord community[/url], the best place to make the wait for the new game a bit more enjoyable. Any questions you have, you can ask there. Discuss the game world with like-minded players, share your ideas and suggestions, and be among the first to hear any news about the game!

notes.title: New game — Mother of All Secrets!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! We're thrilled to announce our new project [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747660/Mother_of_All_Secrets/][b]Mother of All Secrets[/b][/url], an RPG of mythical intrigues and occult mysteries.
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747660/Mother_of_All_Secrets/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747660/Mother_of_All_Secrets/][b]Mother of All Secrets[/b][/url], a mystery RPG about an orphanage where the fates of the heroes irreversibly change with every tick of the clock. Become one of the pupils and unravel the mysteries of the House by influencing the minds, hearts, and plans of its inhabitants.
 
Here's an official trailer:
 
[previewyoutube=nlJLqRXFtbA;full][/previewyoutube]
 [b][h3]Key features:
[/h3][/b]
[b]A living breathing house.[/b] Become a part of the close-knit community of the orphanage. Other wards, your teachers, caretakers, and even the family of House owners — behind every living soul, there are goals, plans, and desires. With every hour, individual plots progress, secrets unfold, and choices are made that alter the House forever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38127382/d71c5999e2dfff0d2e71f8f8e4dcf65c545f1aa7.png[/img]

[b]Your own story.[/b] Create your own character and live out a unique story — only you decide how to spend each and every hour. Go about uncovering the asylum's secrets however you like. Make friends or enemies at your own discretion. Explore the darkest and most dangerous corners of the House. Unravel other people's schemes and draw up your own plans. Obey or risk breaking the cryptic rules that govern the orphanage and face the consequences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38127382/152641595ae4fd16eb7b9f4974852a47bb0b7184.png[/img]

[b]High stakes. [/b]Perform actions in every scene by playing cards. These cards determine your character's skills, items, and even relationships. Different cards allow you to influence others, gain an upper hand during encounters, apply the knowledge and traits you have acquired, or push the narrative towards the desired outcome. Remember that other characters possess their own set of cards which they can play against you! Study the abilities and intentions of others before reshuffling their decks and transforming their personalities.

 
[b][h3]Wishlist Mother of All Secrets on Steam[/h3][/b] 
  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747660/Mother_of_All_Secrets/

[h3]Don't forget to join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/dMrUWarqys]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/MoS_severstudio]Twitter[/url][/h3]

notes.title: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante 26.02 update — full patch notes
notes.content:
Hey, dear Steamers!

We stand ready to deploy a small patch in order to improve your gaming experience. The update will become available today. Please find the shortlist of changes below:

1. We improved the game parameters balance. During the testing phase, we figured out that some of the personal skills such as Manipulation, Diplomacy, etc. have to be tuned in further in the game's chapter so that gamers can achieve certain events. Thus we had to change a game's balance in the free version of the game as well.
2. Some of the UX/UI elements were slightly enhanced - animated, colored, enlarged, etc. to improve text readability.
3. Performance optimization. The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante is a text-based roleplaying game and it was important for us to make sure it runs smoothly on average gaming PCs. 
4. Windowed mode was added to the Video settings menu which going to improve your streaming experience. 

Add The Life and Suffering of Brante to your wishlist and subscribe to our news so that you don't miss the upcoming release

notes.title: The most popular questions about The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone! It has been almost a month since The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante Chapter 1&2 release and we received amazingly positive feedback from players all over the world. However, there were also many queries regarding the game itself, its lore, as well as some of the mechanics.

[b]Before everybody goes off for the holidays, we’d like to clarify a few important points and answer some of the most popular questions about The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante.[/b]

[h3]When will the game be released?[/h3]

All we can say right now is that The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante is slated for a Q1 2021 release and we’ll definitely announce more accurate information on the official Steam page in due time. Please, make sure you wishlisted the game if you would like to be notified when that happens!

[h3]How much will the game cost?[/h3]

At the moment, we’re still working on The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante's English localization, so the price has not been set yet. Rest assured that - as an indie title - it’ll be affordable!

[h3]Will the saves from the free version carry over to the full game?[/h3]

Yes, they will! We're implementing this feature right now. ;) However, if you have an older version of the demo installed (released before the 1st of December), we recommend you update it and start your journey over as it may not be possible to transfer progress from those outdated versions.

[h3]How exactly are you supposed to pronounce “Brante”?[/h3]

What we had in mind when coming up with the protagonist’s name is that it should sound a little French, thus we typically stress the very last syllable - Branté. But honestly, the game is set in an imaginary fantasy world, so you can pronounce it however you wish. :)

[h3]I found a typo/encountered a bug in-game, where can I report it?[/h3]

We are well aware of the problems with the text and our team of editors is currently working to resolve them. Rest assured that the typos will be fixed soon. Nonetheless, if you noticed something that needs reporting or have any other concerns, please feel free to share them in the game’s Discussions section on Steam (it may be a good idea to run a search for similar issues first if only to keep related reports neatly packed in the same thread)!

[h3]Any plans for a MacOS, mobile, or console version of the game?[/h3]

Unfortunately, we’ve no plans to port the game right now but will definitely consider this possibility in the future.

[h3]Why did you implement the Willpower stat? I can’t make certain choices due to lack of Willpower points and it is quite annoying.[/h3]

Our original idea was to highlight the fact that the protagonist is not an almighty superhuman and his inner resources are limited. Oftentimes he needs to "pay" for the privilege of following his heart.
It's all about choice and strategy - would you rather spend your Willpower now or save it for a more important event that may or may not happen in the future? Just like in real life, one has to think ahead and decide what they are willing to sacrifice in order to achieve their goals.

[h3]Will the game be available in Early Access?[/h3]

No, we do not plan to have an Early Access launch for The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante. However, you can support the game by preordering it on [url=https://store.101xp.com/brante/en/]the publisher’s website[/url], which comes with a set of pleasant bonuses!

[h3]Is there a chance for the story to end prematurely with the protagonist's true death?[/h3]

Yes, in the full version of the game, your playthrough might end rather abruptly if you take too many uncalculated risks. That's why we implemented the option to return to the beginning of the current chapter, giving players the opportunity to rethink their choices. :)

[h3]Will The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante be available only in English and Russian? Do you plan to add more languages later on?[/h3]

The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante is twice the size of the “Hobbit” novel by J.R.R. Tolkien and boasts more than 200K words.
As you can imagine, it’s an ENORMOUS amount of content in need of translation and editing. Therefore it was decided to release the game in Russian and English first, then, if the title generates enough interest from players around the globe, we will consider adding support for other languages as well.

_________

Hope we answered some of your questions and cleared up any concerns you might have had about the project. If your question does not fall into any of the categories mentioned above, feel free to leave a comment under this article or start a new thread in the Discussions section. 

Thank you wholeheartedly for your amazing support! We wish all of you very Happy Holidays!

Kindest regards,
Sever Studio and 101XP
